add.reason: OSM maps Yale's tee pads as small golf=fairway ways and the tees themselves as points; data/yale/make_tees.py copies each pad as a tee polygon and tags the pad nearest the 2026 card for Long and Championship (hole, tee_set); hole 12's back pad traced from the 2023 lidar DEM, hole 14's strip cut at its green marker

streams OSM maps only as lines, within 30 m of hole lines (s03): along the inside of 6's dogleg (the 'Burnside') and the brook beside 11, 12 and 18; channels from the 2023 DEM (pipeline/propose_channels.py); red like all water (standing default); flatten=no keeps the falling bed. Left out: the parts outside the OSM boundary (w824708346 above the 6th green, w1043294986 into Griest Pond behind the 9th tee, w1058435186 east of 12; out of bounds there anyway), the 6 m stub w1058435182 and the piped parts (tunnel=culvert/flooded: w1058435178, 180, 184)
